info.title: API.SH: B&Q
info.description: The B&Q API from API.SH: public B&Q data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
B&Q's department and category tree as the shop's menu shows it: name, category id and link of every department, category and menu shortcut (shortcuts carry a filter in their link). With `id`, that one category and its children.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bq-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category id, e.g. DIY637279.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one B&Q department or category page, with the same fields, filters, sort and paging as search, plus the category's name, description and breadcrumbs. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. A department landing page (e.g. Hand Tools) has no product list: it answers `landing_page: true` with its sub-categories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bq-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id from /bq/v1/categories (e.g. DIY637279), or any diy.com /departments/....cat link (`url` in search `categories` and product breadcrumbs); categories that are not in the shop menu need their link.

parameters.description: Any other filter of the page as Name:value (from `filters`), several comma-separated.

Customer reviews of one B&Q product: rating, title, text, author nickname, date, recommended, helpful votes, verified-purchaser and incentivized flags, quality/value/ease-of-use ratings, photos and B&Q's replies; plus the average rating, review count and rating distribution. get.description:
Products on B&Q (diy.com, including its marketplace sellers) for a search: id, EAN, name, link, price, ex-VAT price, was-price and saving, rating and review count, seller, status, category, promotions and badges, home delivery / click-and-collect / in-store flags, image and key features, 48 per page; plus the total, sponsored products, the matching categories with counts and every filter of the page with its values and counts. Filter by price, rating, brand, seller, delivery option, category or any of the page's own attribute filters; sort by relevance, price, rating or newest. Searches the shop sends to a department page ("drill") are answered from that page; an EAN goes straight to its product. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bq-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words, a product name or an EAN.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the results.

parameters.name: min_price

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price, GBP.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-4.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand, or several comma-separated (values from the Brand filter).

parameters.name: sold_by
parameters.description: Seller filter value, e.g. B&Q or Verified seller.

parameters.name: delivery
parameters.description: Delivery option filter value, e.g. Click + Collect, Next day Click + Collect, In-store.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id from `categories`, e.g. DIY779600.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other filter of the page as Name:value (names and values from `filters`), several comma-separated, e.g. Colour group:Black,Pack type:Set.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: B&Q product at one store: aisle, bay, pickup and delivery
get.description:
Where one product is at one B&Q store and how to get it: in-store stock level and quantity with the aisle and bay it sits in (when the store publishes them), click & collect from the store (same/next day, quantity), click & collect from the fulfilment centre (lead time in days, quantity), marketplace click & collect, and home delivery availability and messages for a postcode (the store's own postcode by default); plus the store's address, phone, collection message and the next 7 days' opening hours.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bq-store-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product's EAN, its id (e.g. 4053423232615_BQ) or its diy.com link.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: The store's id from /bq/v1/stores.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A full UK postcode for the home delivery answer (default: the store's postcode).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Stock of one or more B&Q products in the stores nearest to a postcode or point (or at one store): per store the stock level (InStock, LowStock, OutOfStock, NotStockedInStore), the quantity on hand and the shop's message, plus click & collect availability and type (same day, next day, from the fulfilment centre with its lead time), with the store's name, type, address, distance, phone and today's hours. Unknown EANs answer 404 (or are listed in `unknown_eans` when other products in the call are known). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bq-store-stock

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product's EAN (`ean` in search), its id (e.g. 4053423232615_BQ) or its diy.com link; up to 10, comma-separated.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A UK postcode or outward code: the stores nearest to it. One of postcode, lat+lng or store_id is required.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of a point in the UK (with lng), instead of postcode.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of a point in the UK (with lat).

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Only this store (id from /bq/v1/stores).

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true: only stores that have at least one unit on hand.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores per page, 1-20 (default 10).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
B&Q stores in the UK, nearest first to a postcode or a point (or the whole estate when no location is given), or one store by id: name, store type (Warehouse, Mini-Warehouse, Supercentre, Local), address and postcode, coordinates, distance, phone and store email, weekly opening hours and the next 7 days' hours, open today, facilities (key cutting, paint mixing, trade counter...), click & collect options and any store notice. Filter by store type. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bq-stores

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A UK postcode (SE1 5BA) or outward code (SE1): stores nearest to it.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of a point in the UK (with lng), instead of postcode.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of a point in the UK (with lat).

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: One store by its id (`id` in the list, e.g. 1037): returns that store with every field.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only stores of this type (matches part of the name, case-insensitive), e.g. warehouse, supercentre, local, mini-warehouse.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores per page, 1-25 (default 10).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
